title: Chapter 323 Military General Team
content:
Chapter 323 Military General Team

Sure enough, as soon as the Dragon-Breaking Stone appeared, General Arif Ubol sighed and ordered a withdrawal.

The undead warriors trapped in the city were quickly eliminated.

This exploratory attack lasted nearly seven hours.

The elite undead did not appear, but they tested some of the strength of Shanhai City, which was a draw.

The leaders of both sides knew that the other side still had a trump card to play.

Seeing the undead retreat, huge cheers broke out on the city wall.

The soldiers who survived the disaster enjoyed the joy of victory in the battle.

However, most of the commanders, lords and mayors did not applaud and cheer, because they knew that more tragic battles were still to come.

Wang Shuo also came to the quartermaster.

The weapons and equipment of the Red Flame Army have been upgraded to an extreme level. To go further, rare equipment is needed.

The number of quartermasters cannot meet the needs of all the Red Flame Army. More importantly, these rare equipment are all unique. At the same time, Wang Shuo does not have so many military merit points.

After thinking about it, Wang Shuo gave up the idea of exchanging equipment.

After searching carefully, he found a large number of talismans.

Defense enhancement talismans, attack enhancement talismans, and death talismans...

This kind of death talisman has almost the same effect as Wang Shuo's dead spirit beads.

Wang Shuo's military merit points at this time have reached 3 million, and the exchange point of a reinforcement talisman is 100 points.

Wang Shuo directly exchanged 15,000 defense enhancement talismans and 15,000 attack enhancement talismans.

Both of these talismans increase the ability by 25%, which can be said to be very good items.

In the evening, Suo Yong gathered all the lords again.

"Everyone, everyone's performance today is very good, but tomorrow's battle will be more intense."

"We need to gather all the generals together to form a special force to block the opponent's top combat power."

"War generals?"

Wang Shuo guessed secretly.

Suo Yong didn't say much.

Then, everyone counted the number of generals in their hands.

There is no doubt that in the East Gate area.

The Changping County coalition army led by Wang Shuo had the largest number of generals, accounting for almost one-third.

Suo Yong directly let Wang Shuo serve as a team leader and be responsible for the generals under his command.

As for the generals of other lords, he appointed two top generals under his command to be in charge.

Back to the camp, Wang Shuo summoned all the generals of Changping County to the square outside the big tent.

Unexpectedly, there were more than 100 people.

There were 20 senior generals. Of course, there were eight people in Wana Town alone, including Wang Shuo, Gong Zheng, Ayub, Gude, Ye Tianba, Li Jianguo, Gong Kai, and Gong Ping.

Others included Lin Dabiao and Bu Lanlan from Qinghe Town, Zheng Zhongji and Fang Daguang from Xiaochi Town, and Su Xiu and others.

Wang Shuo thought about it and transferred the senior and intermediate generals from the hands of each lord.

As for the junior generals and the lords themselves, they stayed in their own defense areas and were responsible for command.

If all high-end combat forces were withdrawn, the defense of the city wall would be in chaos.

In the end, Wang Shuo's team of generals consisted of 15 high-level generals and 34 mid-level generals.

During the formation process, there were naturally many lords who were unwilling to let their trusted generals leave them.

Wang Shuo persuaded them and brought up Sauron, and these people reluctantly agreed.

There were also some lords who took the initiative to ask their generals to replace them and join the team of generals.

Wang Shuo also readily agreed. Among these lords was Su Xiu.

His move made Wang Shuo look at him with a higher eye.

Even the unjust act of "selling" himself at the beginning, Wang Shuo didn't mind it much.

After all, it was understandable that he made this move in order to preserve his strength at that time.
